# Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol

## Scope

\- Storage(SPA Type)

03 Register range: 0-124, 1000-1124

04 Register range: 1000-1124, 2000-2124, 1125-1249



## Protocol Register

It is 16 bits (two bytes) unsigned integer for each holding and input register.
